19085.summary: Skillfully hide from and sneak past the enemies fields of view, take their formations apart and hide their bodies to cover your tracks. Quick Save will enable you to execute your plans perfectly. Tactically plan actions for your whole team and execute them all at once. Make use of the vertical gameplay and jump from roof to roof to silently kill your foes from above.
19085.storyline:
In the year 1615 in Japan, a new Shogun seizes power over Japan and enforces nationwide peace. In his battle against conspiracy and rebellion, he recruits five specialists in assassination, sabotage and espionage.

The team must fight against the mysterious Kage-sama, who plans to overthrow the Shogun. They infiltrate castles, gather information through espionage, fight rebellions and ruthlessly eliminate Kage-sama’s allies. The group is comprised of very different personalities; working together as a team seems impossible at first. Yet over the course of many missions, trust is won and friendships are made. The characters develop their own dynamic and each member will face some kind of personal drama.

31885.summary: A fantasy action roguelike of exploration and murder. Live, kill, die, improve, live again.

68285.summary: Sequel to the original Mobile Suit Gundam: Battle Operation. This is a free-to-play team battle action game based on the "Mobile Suit Gundam" series of the Universal Century. Become the strongest MS pilot through 6 vs. 6 battles!

81985.summary: Tower defense reimagined! Dead Ground is a procedurally generated tower defense game with rogue-like elements. Each playthrough will offer randomly generated guns, skills and augments. You'll have to travel, collect scrap, water, manage your inventory and upgrade your base to survive!

105285.summary: Susan is back again in the middle of problems of epic proportions deep in the Lost Lands. Weather cataclysm, mythical creatures, ancient legends - these and more stands before the main hero of the Lost Lands.

110685.summary: Take to the air! A wild witch rally begins: Bibi and her friends leap onto their broomsticks and explore exciting worlds. With mysterious witches' potions and turbulent aerial maneuvers, they zoom through the age of the dinosaurs, the Orient, and Transylvania. Whizz-whizz, and off they go!

114085.summary: Redo! is a game about a girl trying to find another human in a dystopian world overrun by biomachines. It's a lonely and evocative game about exploring the unknown and overcoming obstacles to see what is left.

119285.summary: Welcome to the world of Random, a dark kingdom where every citizen’s future is determined by the roll of a dice. Will you be defeated by your fate or embrace chaos and learn to make it work in your favor? Embark on a journey with Even and her sidekick Dicey to play the odds and break the curse of Random.
119285.storyline: Once upon a time, in the kingdom of Random, there lived a mad Queen who controlled a mysterious black dice. By her decree, every child of Random would be given the honor of rolling the dice on their twelfth birthday to determine which realm of the kingdom they belonged to, thereby deciding their fate for all eternity. Roll a one and the child would be sent to Onecroft, destined to live a life of struggle. Roll a three and land in Threedom, a chaotic realm destroyed by civil war. Roll a six, and they would live a life of luxury in the Queen’s dark palace. Or so it was told…

125885.summary:
Sword of the Necromancer is a dungeon-crawler action RPG with Rogue-like elements where you can revive your defeated enemies to make them fight alongside you.

Turn your foes into allies using the forbidden powers of the Sword of the Necromancer and help Tama reach the dungeon's depths in order to gain enough power to bring Koko back from the dead.

Gather a little army of monsters, equip yourself with weapons and relics and level up to take on the guardians that stand between you and your objective
125885.storyline:
Legend says that, deep within these mountains, a heretic decided to violate the will of the gods in order to achieve eternal life.

The heretic succeeded in this aberrant attempt, and created a tool for forbidden rituals that could grant immortality… and even bring back the dead.

Over the years and centuries many have tried to get that power for themselves, but all they found in the Necromancer’s crypt was their demise.

They say that the tool the Necromancer created is also a weapon…

The Sword of the Necromancer

127685.summary: A roguelike deckbuilding game in space! Explore randomly generated systems, enemies and strange encounters. Build your deck, survive and reach For The Warp gate!

127985.summary:
A story about play, connections and adventure.

Step through levels brick by brick with puzzles that ask us to sometimes follow the instructions… and sometimes to be creative and break the rules.

Builder’s Journey is a poetic puzzle that takes place in a LEGO brick world, brought to life with the most accurately rendered LEGO elements yet to feature on screens. Be taken through a breathtaking world filled with brick-by-brick effects, accompanied by a beautiful soundtrack.

Throughout the narrative, there will be ups and downs, challenges and celebrations. Take the time to experiment, and most importantly, to play as figuring out who we are and what we become is the Builder’s Journey.
127985.storyline: Told entirely without words, this gentle and heartfelt tale follows a small brick-built parent and child as they make their way together through a series of intimate, diorama-like worlds. Set among softly lit landscapes assembled from familiar toy bricks, the journey unfolds as a quiet meditation on family, creativity, and the simple joy of play. As the pair travel onward, the child longs to explore, imagine, and build freely, while the parent is pulled between the demands of a structured, grown-up world and the wish to share in that sense of wonder. Guided only by mood, music, and evocative imagery, the story invites players to interpret its meaning for themselves, piecing together an emotional arc about growing up, letting go, and reconnecting. Each scene becomes both a puzzle to solve and a small moment in a larger relationship, celebrating the timeless spirit of building something beautiful, brick by brick.

131785.summary: Amnesia: Rebirth is a new descent into darkness from the creators of the iconic Amnesia series. Set in the desolate landscape of the Algerian desert, the game will focus on new character Tasi Trianon as she sets out on a harrowing journey through devastation and despair, personal terror and pain, while exploring the limits of human resilience.
131785.storyline: Amnesia: Rebirth is a first-person survival horror game set in 1937. Players take on the role of Anastasie "Tasi" Trianon, a French woman whose expedition plane crashes in the Algerian desert, leaving her stranded and unable to recall how she survived. Alone and searching for her missing companions, Tasi presses through sun-scorched caves and ancient ruins, piecing together the terrifying events that unfolded while fighting to hold on to her sanity in the dark. As she descends deeper, she confronts monstrous horrors and buried memories, driven forward by a fierce, desperate resolve to protect what matters most to her.

132385.summary: Autopsy Simulator is a first-person horror-sim hybrid where players take on the role of a practice pathologist and study case files, created in collaboration with real-world forensic doctors, to help guide their dissection of anatomically accurate bodies to determine each subject’s cause of death.
132385.storyline: In Autopsy Simulator: Dead Memories, you play a middle-aged pathologist whose life has taken a turn for the worse. After a career downfall and the loss of your beloved wife, you live each day shattered and exhausted. One day during a routine post-mortem, you find a relic of your past hidden inside a body. Now, it feels like something just won’t let go…

132685.summary: A retro-style video game set in a manga-ish absurd world.
132685.storyline: You are Garlic, an onion-headed boy and you want to climb the Sacred Tower to meet the Cyber Goddess to seduce her...

134585.summary: Iconic PlayStation hero, Sackboy returns in an all-new 3D adventure with a deeply immersive and expressive control scheme. Players can go on this epic platforming journey solo-style, or they can team up with friends for collaborative, chaotic multiplayer fun.
134585.storyline:
The dastardly Vex (a near-mythical being born of chaos and fear, no less) kidnaps Sackboy’s friends and forces them to build his Topsy Turver.

This most deadly diabolical device will transform Craftworld from a fantastical land of pure imagination and innocent dreams… into a torrid, barren eyesore of nightmares. Ooh the fiend!

But legend tells of a prophecy from deep within the ancient order of the Knitted Knights, Craftworld’s legendary protectors. For only the brave, fearless, chivalrous and, yes, gallant can save the day in an almost too dramatic for words race against time stuffed with danger and peril. So much peril.

139185.summary: This is a 3D action role-playing game based on the space fantasy comic/anime Edens Zero by Hiro Mashima, creator of Fairy Tail and Rave Master. The player controls a diverse cast of characters as they embark on an epic adventure across different planets while battling powerful enemies!

142185.summary: “Lost Lands: Redemption” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.
142185.storyline:
Solve the mysteries of the secret temple and find the magic artifact of an ancient deity.
Defeat powerful villains with your attention and persistence!
Dive deep into new and dangerous adventures with old and loyal friends!
The vengeful deity broke free! Stop him before he regains his power!
Find the places safely hidden from prying eyes and reveal their secrets!

142485.summary: Demons of Asteborg is a new original and challenging 2D-platform game mixing action, little puzzles and strategy coming soon for the SEGA Mega Drive and Genesis, Windows, Mac, Linux and Nintendo Switch. This 16-bit game will bring back many memories to the retro-lovers.

151385.summary: Absolute Tactics: Daughters of Mercy is a light-hearted, turn-based RPG adventure that puts a modern spin on classic tactics-style games. Featuring a diverse cast of characters, enormous boss monsters, and a dark world embroiled in war, Absolute Tactics plunges players right into the action as our hero Huxley and his dog Max build their team of allies to defend their home against a mysterious invading army.
151385.storyline: Control your units and make use of their unique traits to dominate your enemies with masterful strategies that take advantage of unit placement, varied attack patterns, and skills that are as unique as each character. A vast array of deadly enemies, traps, puzzles and obstacles await to challenge you on your adventure.

159685.summary: See the tragedy of World War 2 through the eyes of a child. Torn away from your home, you become a worker in a forced labor camp. You have to survive without losing what makes us human in this war-torn world, where only the strongest prevail.

165385.summary: Cottagecore cozy adventure game about delivering mail to forest animals! take on the role of a fresh-on-the-job Mail Scout given her very first letter to deliver. All you have to do is find out exactly where the recipient Greg lives and deliver the letter, no biggie!
165385.storyline:
Take on the role of a fresh-on-the-job Mail Scout on track to complete your very first mail delivery! You’ve been tasked with a letter to ‘Greg’ but the only thing you know is that he lives somewhere in Grumblewood Grove. Glide, jump and talk your way through the Grove on your way to deliver the letter.
All you have to figure out where exactly this Greg lives and hand him the letter, no biggie!

194185.summary:
Talismans are magical items that contain great power, even with some that can grant any desire. Kronos, a boy training as a wizard, and Serene, who consider one another as siblings, become enveloped in a Talisman conspiracy. Will they be able to save themselves and the world from the threatening danger?

Equip Talismans to the Skill Board to acquire skills and fatal moves to turn the tides in turn-based battles. Forging and upgrading weapons, armor and Talismans from materials will grant you additional advantages. There are also strategic elements with battle formations and traps, and not to mention the variety of quests, arena and monster achievements that await as challenges!
194185.storyline: Talismans are magical items that contain great power, even with some that can grant any desire. Kronos, a boy training as a wizard, and Serene, who consider one another as siblings, become enveloped in a Talisman conspiracy. Will they be able to save themselves and the world from the threatening danger?

197685.summary: Team up with your friends & family and explore the peculiar universe of ADIOS Amigos. A game with serious astrophysics in a comic setting for 1-4 players. Explore solar systems and discover planets, space stations, aliens, and artifacts. Improvise fuel efficient trajectories to keep your rusty ship running (and you might see your home planet once again). Toy with accurate and delightful space physics. Break into a space station with an asteroid. Tow a sofa into a black hole. Normal stuff.

198385.summary: At the end of the 21st century, humanity was forced to escape the planet that was under attack by the mysterious mechanical lifeforms called Weiss. Half a century to the galaxy, the omnipotent artificial intelligence "Alice" discover emissions. Young women who are able to use it are called "Actresses". The battle against Weiss changed completely and brought peace again. One day, the organization Aegis requested a combat simulation system for a demonstrative test between "CS" and Actresses.
198385.storyline: At the end of the 21st century, humanity was forced to escape the planet that was under attack by the mysterious mechanical lifeforms called Weiss. Half a century to the galaxy, the omnipotent artificial intelligence "ALICE" discover emissions. Young women who are able to use it are called "Actresses". The battle against Weiss changed completely and brought peace again. One day, the organization AEGIS requested a combat simulation system for a demonstrative test between "CS" and Actresses.

203685.summary: Become one of the biggest wine company in the world with this breathtaking story of young entrepreneur with small dream which comes through.

203885.summary: Another chapter of the atmospheric horror series has emerged from the shadows! Eerie sound design and shadowy environments set the stage for gruesome and terrifying ghosts never seen before in the series.
203885.storyline: A young girl awakens in a dark, unfamiliar forest with no recollection of how she got there. As she searches for the way out, she crosses paths with a mysterious individual who reveals to her that she’s been cursed. In order to break the curse, she needs to explore the streets of her town at night to seek out her lost memories. However, malevolent ghosts lurk within the shadows, and the girl must avoid them by running, hiding, and shutting her eyes if she hopes to survive long enough to break her curse.

210585.summary: Face the Lords of the Void and their endless minions, collect their Soulstones and become a god! In this Action Roguelite, unveil secret spells, craft mighty weapons, unlock multiple characters, discover game-breaking synergies and conquer the power of the void.

212585.summary: An indie graphic adventure / visual novel game in the style of PC-98 titles. Players take on the role of a ship's security officer in deep space near Jupiter as a deadly mystery threatens the entire crew.
212585.storyline: Stories from Sol: The Gun-Dog takes place in a vintage anime and sci-fi inspired retro future. Players take control of a security officer transferred to the Jovian warship 'The Gun-Dog' as it heads into deep space to investigate reports of mysterious signals. As things begin to unravel on the Gun-Dog the player has to navigate the slow breakdown of the crew and do their best to uncover the mystery of the threat from deep space before it is too late.

212785.summary: NHRA is back – bigger and better than ever! Immerse yourself into the teams, tracks, tuning, and strategies, then strap into the driver’s seat in your ultimate quest to become the Champion among the true Beasts of the Strip. Key Game Features: • 5 NHRA…

213585.summary: Hello, I'm Noah. I'm 28 years old and still haven't got a single date in my life, I'm looking for a life coach who can help me figure out the hard choices in my day to day life, you know? I'm sad and single, I have some friends online, but that's it.

218285.summary: Join Big C on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

226385.summary: Players will help a white-robed girl and her friends uncover the truth of the planet using unique dash gameplay. The storyline is fully voiced by renowned actors, with meticulously designed levels and energetic music for you to enjoy!
226385.storyline:
A young girl awakens from a laboratory and embarks on a journey to uncover the truth with her former companions.
Along the way, she encounters peculiar extraterrestrial beings and faces various challenging obstacles.
In order to recover her memories,
the player must guide her and her companions through numerous crises and uncover the secrets of the planet.
The objective is to escape from this celestial body!

233585.summary: As wannabe rockstar Chai, you’ll fight back against a sinister robotics enhancement conglomerate using rhythm-amplified combat where everything – from the motion in the environment to the blows of combat – is synced to the music.
233585.storyline: 25-year-old Chai joins Project Armstrong, an experimental prosthetics program, at the robotics company Vandelay Technologies to realize his dream of being a rockstar. However, when his music player ends up implanted in his chest, the company labels him a defect! Alongside new allies, Chai must use his new musical powers to uncover a mysterious conspiracy within Vandelay's upper management.

234285.summary: A port of Ridge Racer 2, originally released on the PSP, enhanced for PS4/PS5 with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

235085.summary: BrokenLore: Unfollow is a surreal horror game where you play as a victim of bullying, fighting terrifying monsters as you uncover a dark mystery in a thrilling journey of terror. It pushes you to the edge of your seat as you explore the dark impact of social media on mental health.
235085.storyline:
Anne wakes up to a silent, empty house with memories of how she got there… And she’s not alone. A horror game focusing on the dark side of social media. Featuring social media influencers Akidearest, Knite, Kin Ryan, and Elisa True Crime.

To escape, Anne is forced to explore the rooms in the house and come to terms with the most painful choices of her past. However, she’s not alone. A horrible creature wanders around and follows her every step... Will Anne be able to get out?

238185.summary: Metroidvania movement gameplay with soul-selling lootbox-based customization

239385.summary: The next exciting entry in the STORM series, celebrating the 20th anniversary of Naruto's anime debut, releases 2023! The game features new playable characters in addition to the 124 ninjas from past series! Plus, it connects key moments from the first four STORM entries into one game for the first time.

242285.summary: Poetic, philosophical and challenging platformer experience? That's all about Words of Wisdow — innovative mix of hardcore platformer with text riddles and word puzzles.

244485.summary: Face the interstellar Archangels in a turn-based tactical game with deckbuilding elements and destructible environment, where you pilot powerful mechs to save the Earth from destruction.
244485.storyline:
Face the incoming alien threat, known as Angels, that traveled interstellar space in their seed pods and arrived on Earth bringing death and destruction.

You will need to upgrade your mech, manage your weapons and equipment. Build the perfect deck combination and survive all the incoming Archangels.
You can also build your city defenses and with appropriate funding create the perfect city fortress.

247085.summary:
Roll, jump, bounce and ‘boing’ your way through a mysterious moonlit fairground built by the mischievous BuiBui. Just watch out for the fiendish traps and devious hazards they’ve left behind!

16 classic LocoRoco levels in this playful platformer originally released on the PSP, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

247785.summary: Beach Invasion 1945: Pacific is a WWII FPS game where you defend the fortified Pacific island beaches against invading forces who will attack you with troops, tanks, planes and more! Use the iconic Japanese and American WWII weaponry, and prepare your defenses with mines, explosives and bonuses!

252485.summary: Take control of one of the commandos, team up with your friends and send the Sludge God and its horde of things-that-should-never-be back to the underworld. Choose the class that matches your playstyle, pile into your favorite ride, and unload an array of gunfire, grenades, special abilities, and freaking katanas as you save the planet.
252485.storyline: In the near future, an experimental attempt to harness the power of the Earth’s core ends in a terrifying disaster: the release of the Sludge God. This eldritch abomination begins terraforming the area, turning soil to scum and the living to undead monsters. Luckily, the genius behind the experiment has a plan to make things right. All he needs is a team of competent, highly trained mercenaries to get the job done. … Unfortunately, they were all too expensive. Which is why he’s hired… The Toxic Commandos.

255085.summary: In Avatar: The Last Airbender - Quest for Balance you'll be playing as one of nine characters - Aang, Toph, Sokka, and Katara are all confirmed - utilizing the four elements (earth, wind, fire, and water) to solve puzzles.

257485.summary: Unleash your creativity and paint your way pixel by pixel!

261085.summary: You are humanity's last hope to stop the Strogg, a hostile alien race waging war against Earth. Play this military sci-fi FPS, now upgraded for modern platforms with improved visuals, new campaign content, online multiplayer/co-op, and more.

264485.summary: This is a platform jumping game for delivering goods in a limited time category. Players need to avoid obstacles, mechanisms, and monsters along the way, and can kill them. Completing challenging levels within a limited time will earn rewards, but there will be no rewards beyond that time.

265085.summary:
Tappump is a fast-paced one-button game.

You control the circle. Your goal is to move forward while avoiding mines and staying within the horizontal boundaries of the screen. Press the button to jump, hold the button to increase range. Collect coins to earn points.

If you hit a mine or go beyond the top or bottom of the screen, the game is over.

266985.summary: Adventure and submarine exploration game. Control your Bathyscaphe with the help of a logbook. Through the game puzzles, bullet-hell sequences, and skill-based challenges, you will be plunged miles and miles into the depths where the ocean seems to have no end.

270485.summary: Blast your way through an endless maze inhabited by deadly robots and their invulnerable, menacing master Evil Otto. Tag in a friend in local co-op to help you survive this twin-stick revival of an arcade classic.

274785.summary: This is a role-playing game with RPG-survival elements, based on an alternative history of ancient Slavs. You'll also find numerous references and plots based on Slavic mythology and fairy tales. Explore the open game world on your own or with friends.

279485.summary: NanoApostle is a dark sci-fi boss rush action game featuring intense reaction-based combat and the unique "Destruction Point" system. Play as Anita, a child augmented with lethal nanomachines, as she battles against twisted cybernetic experiments to escape a top-secret facility.

284785.summary: Clear retro 3D levels or build your own in this 3D action platformer for all ages!

287585.summary: Pink Pong is a classic arcade-style game where two players compete in a fast-paced and skillful showdown. Take control of your paddle and go head-to-head with your opponent in a thrilling battle of reflexes and precision. Use your paddle to bounce the ball past your adversary and score points, but be on guard - they're aiming to do the same! The first player to reach the target score wins. Enjoy the timeless simplicity and competitive fun of this classic arcade game brought to the digital age. Pink Pong is perfect for quick matches and high-energy gaming sessions.

287885.summary: A port of Jet Moto 2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

290285.summary: Spin the Lighthouse offers a serene and meditative escape, inviting players to embark on a journey of relaxation. With a focus on simplicity and peaceful interactions, this game is designed for individuals of all ages who seek a moment of tranquility after a hectic day. Spin and unwind – "Spin the Lighthouse" is your ticket to a peaceful and rejuvenating gaming experience. Find your calm, one rotation at a time.

293885.summary: Seized by criminals, the island designated for your research needs your help. Join Yatziri and the Wazhari tribe to liberate their hostages, explore hidden secrets, craft essential items and weapons, and strategically use fire and water in challenging puzzles and life-or-death battles for survival.

295885.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build the dungeon you fight through. Each night use your cards to expand the ruins then battle through them harvesting Glimour from the residents, so The Maiden may grant your heart’s desire. But be warned - eventually your trespassing will awaken The Warden.

302785.summary: A 2D platform shooter where you DESTROY!! Get Elemental Powers from the Prysms and help Amor defeat the Primordial Threats agains Humanity! Get cute costumes and be stylish!

303585.summary: Immerse yourself in the epic battles of "Insectum" and unleash the power of your monstrous insects. Face off against your rivals on the battlefield by strategically using cards.

305985.summary: Dive into the heart-pounding action of "Air Sea Modern Conflict," an exhilarating game where you take direct control of powerful ships and aircraft to annihilate waves of relentless enemies. As a skilled commander, you'll pilot various naval vessels, from agile destroyers and stealthy submarines to massive aircraft carriers, each armed with an array of devastating weapons. Take to the skies with an impressive selection of aircraft, including nimble fighters, heavy bombers, drones and versatile helicopters, to dominate both land and sea.

309585.summary: Melding the intensity of arcade racing with the agility of parkour, Distance catapults you into a neon-soaked world shrouded in mystery. Adapt quickly using your car’s abilities to jump, flip, and fly to overcome deadly hazards and survive.

310885.summary: Leave the hustle of the city behind and embrace life on Starsand Island. Fish, farm, raise animals, and befriend or fall in love with locals to learn their secrets. Customize your world with our DIY system, and invite friends to help build your dream paradise!

314685.summary: Correct Picture is an engaging and educational game where players are challenged to match pictures on the left with their corresponding names on the right. The objective is to correctly pair as many names with images as possible. The more correct matches a player makes, the higher their score. This game tests and improves the player's recognition and association skills, making it both fun and informative.

315385.summary: Challenge yourself in Driving Is Hard! Drive a bathtub on wheels through steep, unforgiving terrain where every mistake costs you progress. Master tough physics-based gameplay, sharpen your patience, and uncover Jeff’s journey of self-doubt, family struggles, and emotional growth as he finds strength, self-acceptance, and hope for a brighter future.
315385.storyline: Jack sets off on a personal journey in a DIY bathtub car, battling harsh terrains that mirror his inner struggles. As he navigates through self-doubt, rising defiance, and eventual acceptance, he confronts his father’s critical voice. Through each challenge, Jack grows closer to reconciling with his past and finding peace, ultimately embracing his own self-worth and independence without the need for external approval.

320785.summary: Race against tiny troublemakers across dozens of crazy courses and take on unique and thrilling trials! Ride on single tracks, unleash powerful items against your rivals, or face off in exhilarating challenges to compete for the championships!

325785.summary: Repair your spaceship and return home!

325885.summary: Guide a mischievous kid back to his parents in a vibrant side-scrolling adventure!

328085.summary: Animation System Visual Novel "Thinking of You Beyond Time"

333985.summary: Free your mind with Feverdream: Rainbow Chaser, a free cross-platform multiplayer shooter. Team up with friends to create and surf rainbows in any direction, as you track and eliminate assigned player targets in a surreal desert environment.

334985.summary: Dark Receipt is a short, intense psychological horror game featuring retro visual styles…

335285.summary: Kingdom Loop is a strategic roguelike autobattler focused on building your army and kingdom. Explore many tile combinations, items, and units in search of the perfect setup to beat the Ancient Kings!

337185.summary:
MTG - Motocross The Game is the materialization of nearly 30 years' experience in both motocross and video games. The entire core project team is or has been a motocross racer, and is an active member of existing motocross video game communities.

MTG is the game that gamers have been dreaming of for decades: A hyper-realistic motocross simulator based on online competition, available on both PC and next-gen consoles, with cross-play capabilities.

345985.summary: Blast through monster hordes with crazy weapons in a wild bullet hell! It’s chaotic, casual, and seriously fun!

348685.summary: A tactical Tower Defense with the ability to reposition your troops! Deploy your available warriors to hold back the forces of darkness engulfing the kingdom.

349585.summary: Arrr you ready for more puzzlin', plunderin' and perilous tentacles?

357185.summary: Second Coat is a fast-paced multiplayer paintball game where players compete against each other by using strategy and skill to outmaneuver opponents, rack up eliminations, and achieve victory.
357185.storyline: Welcome to the adrenaline-fueled world of Second Coat, where vibrant colors collide, strategy reigns supreme, and every splatter counts. In this intense urban paintball game, you’ll need determination, focus, and a steady trigger finger. Play with friends to defeat the enemy in several realistic environments and game modes.

362185.summary: This game throws you into a brutal arena where endless hordes rise and only raw skill keeps you alive.

375885.summary: Step into the world of Delivery Dash Co., where every package counts and every second matters! With randomized delivery locations, hazards around every corner, and arcade-style bonuses, every run is a fresh adventure—whether you’re competing against rivals or shaping your own courier story.

376985.summary: Saint Slayer is an NES-style 2D action game, featuring loads of stages, enemies, and gore set against the backdrop of late-17th century Europe. Play as the ex-soldier Rudiger and wield the Spear of Sacrilege as you save the Holy Roman Empire from the corrupt Catholic priest Father Pacer.
376985.storyline: The year is 1698. A mysterious figure named Father Pacer has shattered the peace negotiated after the War of the Grand Alliance, obsessively and violently stealing Catholic relics throughout the Holy Roman Empire. Can the ex-soldier-turned-farmer Rudiger protect his people from a power-mad priest and his horde of monsters and minions? Can he become Saint Slayer?

388285.summary:
Wardogs is a first-person tactical multiplayer shooter built around large-scale combined-arms battles for up to 100 players. Three teams compete to control randomized objective zones across destructible battlefields, using infantry weapons, vehicles, logistics, fortifications, and proximity voice chat.

Players earn cash and XP through combat, support, transportation, and objective play, then spend persistent cash on custom loadouts, equipment, and vehicles across lives and matches.
388285.storyline: Three rival private military companies fight for cash, influence, and control over a strategically important region in a fictional Eastern European setting.

390785.summary:
One strike decides your fate:

Enter a world of silhouettes and steel in Fatal Slash, a minimalist 2D dueling game of precision, timing, and tension. Every encounter is a deadly test where a single cut can end the fight. There are no long combos or super moves - only patience, skill, and the courage to strike first.

392285.summary: Join Hori and his lovable crew of baby astronauts and their loyal Bernese Mountain Dog, Charlie, as they blast off on a thrilling journey across the galaxy! In The Adventures of Hori, you'll unravel cosmic mysteries, outsmart villainous cats known as the “Ronronneurs Maléfiques,” and discover magical objects like the Destructive Lollipop, all while forging bonds of friendship and teamwork. This heartwarming and humorous space tale is brought to life with adorable cartoon visuals, interactive choices, and immersive storytelling perfect for young players and families alike.

395285.summary: Wreck Runners is a 1-4 player online co-op extraction game set in a haunted and ever-changing Bermuda Triangle. Hired by the suspiciously cheerful Trustwell Corporation, your crew of runners is sent in to recover valuable salvage. We expect you may find far more than sunken wrecks waiting in the Fog.

405385.summary: RON GUARD: Day Zero is a sci-fi tower defense game made in the spirit of classic RTS games. Lives of the surviving crew members are in your hands. Find out why the terraformer robots have rebelled and help evacuate your crew from an unknown planet, where survival is the new frontier.

414985.summary:
A 1-3 person cooperative action‑adventure set in a sprawling Arabian fantasy world.
Soar across mythic landscapes on nimble flying carpets, battle colossal jinn that tower above the world, and unravel a tale of betrayal that threatens to tear the world apart. Inspired by One Thousand and One Nights, this is a shared journey where exploration, combat, and storytelling are woven into a single, unforgettable experience.

415285.summary: Fast-paced action roguelite where greed meets relentless combat, demanding ever stronger builds and sacrifices. Cut through hordes of monsters, arrange Relics into devastating arcane synergies, and gamble your newfound fortune for the strength to escape a temple determined to take it all back.

415385.storyline: Up in the heavens, eight angel sisters lived much like any sisters do: they argued a lot. One day, a decree came down from on high. One... and only one... of the sisters would be chosen to become an archangel, but it was up to them to decide who it would be. It was decided that each of them would make a pact with a warrior on Earth, through whom they would fight, and the winner of a grand tournament would be chosen to become the new archangel.

421585.summary: In this uncompromising first-person shooter, storm the Wolf’s Lair in 1944, the sealed-off power centre of the Nazi leadership. Fight your way through bunkers, defensive positions and Nazi troops using weapons, explosives and vehicles, and eliminate officers all the way up to Hitler himself.

423385.summary: Embark on an epic fantasy JRPG in Alphadia F, the remake of Alphadia IV. Explore Valhalard, uncover the mystery of six fallen crystals, and save four kingdoms in strategic turn-based battles. Master the energi system, character progression, cooking, and classic anime-style RPG adventure.
